comment: http_request whose response is a file. pdf_call downloads a real PDF: the output must be body null plus files[0] = { document_id: file_dummy_*, mime_type: application/pdf, filename: dummy.pdf, size_bytes }. html_call is the control: an HTML page is not a file, so its output stays { status, body: null } with no files. Run with COLMENA_LOCAL=true so the engine has a storage adapter (see docs/developer_guide/32_multimedia_generation.md).
